name: tree_inorder
note: The call stack becomes an explicit stack<Node*>; the left descent is the push loop.

name: tree_preorder
note: Right child is pushed before left, so left is popped first and order is preserved.

name: tree_postorder
note: Two stacks: the first produces root-right-left, the second reverses it.

name: tree_height
note: Breadth-first: each queue drain is one level, so the level count is the height.

name: tree_count_leaves
note: The return value becomes a counter carried outside the loop.

name: tree_invert
note: Swapping is order-independent, so any traversal works - a queue is the simplest.

name: quicksort_ranges
note: The stack holds the (low, high) ranges the recursion would have held in frames.

name: graph_dfs
note: Neighbours are pushed in reverse so the pop order matches the recursive visit order.

name: flood_fill
note: Reads the grid from stdin, so the pair carries the input it needs to be checked.

name: sum_digits_tree
note: Root-to-leaf paths: the stack carries the running value alongside the node.
